gold_note: Vertical strict consensus, read by eye at half and full size. A tip whose line runs straight down through the middle of a bracket and on below it is that node's stem, so its tip belongs to the node (Marshosaurus with Condorraptor and Piatnitzkysaurus; Suchomimus in Spinosauridae; Megalosaurus with the nine megalosauroids and Spinosauridae; Chilantaisaurus with Aerosteon and the Australovenator pair; Siamotyrannus in the four-way sinraptorid node). Tetanurae and the node above it are polytomies (three and four). Neotheropoda, Averostra, Tetanurae, Megalosauroidea, Avetheropoda, Coelurosauria and Allosauroidea are printed beside their nodes and kept; Spinosauridae is printed under the silhouette above the bold tips and kept on their node. Bremer values are not encoded. 58 tips, 8 polytomies (3, 4, 3, 10, 7, 4, 3, 4 children); 8 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
